sens_en: to place, to put, to acquire
origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 置 par « relâcher » : 网, le filet, et 直. 直 se lit zhí, la même syllabe que 置. Relâcher ce qu'on tenait, c'est le poser : placer, mettre, acquérir.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 置 as “to release”: 网, net, and 直. 直 is read zhí, the same syllable as 置. To let go of what you held is to set it down: to place, to put, to acquire.
